{{Quote|Maybe she wanted to add another Jedi kill to her résumé.''"<br />''"Another?''"<br />"''As I told you, the Maladians are very good at what they do.|Sate Pestage and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
The '''Maladians''' were a cult of highly-skilled [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] from the [[Maladi system/Legends|Maladi system]] known to honor all their contracts, as well as being able to wound or kill [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], along with his aide [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], had a [[Unidentified Maladian assassin|Maladian]] assassin [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on Coruscant, around three dozen Maladians were contracted by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] Senator [[Pax Teem]] and other Grans to kill the important [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], who was secretly both the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis and Palpatine's [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]]. However, the Maladians failed in the [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attempt]] on the Muun's life, after Plagueis managed to hold off the assassins long enough for Palpatine and Pestage to arrive in order to save him. Plagueis was nearly killed by the encounter, and was forced to wear a respirator for the rest of his life following the event.

==History==
{{Quote|Have you made a decision about who to use from the data I supplied?''"<br />"''The Maladians.''"<br />"''Can I ask why?''"<br />"''The Mandalorian Death Watch has its own problems, and the Bando Gora its own galactic agenda.''"<br />"''I couldn't agree more. Besides, the Maladians are known to honor all their contracts.|Sate Pestage and Palpatine, on who to use to kill Vidar Kim|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
By [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], the Maladian group had been founded and its members had become well known for their capabilities as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], in an attempt to become the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] representing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the rest of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was secretly the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, hired the Maladians through his aide [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Chommell sector's current Senator, [[Vidar Kim]], on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. For the assassination, Pestage did business with a [[Unidentified Maladian commander|Maladian]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], and later warned the [[Unidentified Maladian assassin|Maladian]] assassin chosen for the mission about [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ronhar Kim]], the Naboo Senator's son. Instructed to make the assassination public, the Maladian opened fire with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on the [[Air taxi/Legends|Air taxi]] carrying Kim and the Jedi while it was on route to Coruscant's [[Mezzileen Spaceport]], in full view of the security [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]]. The blaster fire killed Kim instantly, though the Senator's son was not hit and leapt from the vehicle to the Maladian's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], steering the speeder to the ground after forcefuly taking control of the speeder from the Maladian. The Maladian then spiked herself with [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]], committing suicide to prevent the Jedi from [[Mind trick/Legends|forcing]] information from her. After Kim's death, Palpatine was appointed Senator for the Chommell sector as he was an [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] under Kim before the Senator died.<ref name="Darth P" />

[[File:Attack_on_Plagueis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Plagueis defends himself from the Maladians.]]Over two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later that year, the Maladians conducted another assignment on Coruscant. A faction of Maladians was hired by [[Pax Teem]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] Senator from the world of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], and other members of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] to kill the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] of important [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] allied organization [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], who was also covertly Darth Plagueis, the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] of Palpatine. At the [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|Lodge of the Order of the Canted Circle]] in Coruscant's [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]], the three dozen Maladians hired for this assignment drugged members of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] that were to take part in the initiation of Muun [[Larsh Hill]] into the order, and entered the ceremony that Damask was taking part in disguised as the members they had drugged. The Maladians launched their [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] as the ceremony began. The Maladian disguised as the high official, after placing a pendant around Hill's neck as part of the ceremony, [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] the Muun by pulling downward on the pendant, while other disguised Maladians threw multiple [[decapitator disk]]s at Damask and the others attending the ceremony.<ref name="Darth P" />

The volley wounded Damask in the neck, while many other Muuns attending were killed. Despite a counterattack from one of Damask's surviving [[Sun Guard]]s, the Maladians continued to advance, cutting down those remaining standing with [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] before Damask unleashed the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Multiple Maladians fell as they assaulted the Sith Lord, but were close to finishing the Muun off when Palpatine and Pestage arrived to save Damask. Pestage and Palpatine, who had learned of the attack from the Maladian commander Pestage had previously dealt with and Palpatine's [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] of the event, killed the remaining Maladians with a [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]. Damask, despite his serious wounds, survived the encounter with the Maladians.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Organization==
{{Quote|The Maladian commander I did business with during the Kim affair.''"<br />"''What of him?''"<br />"''He contacted me&mdash;two, maybe three hours ago. He said that he felt humiliated because of the manner in which the Kim contract had been implemented, and wanted to make it up to me.|Sate Pestage and Palpatine|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
An organization split into factions, the Maladians were a cult of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] assassins that were very highly trained. They were known to always honor their contracts, and were respected for their professionalism. At least some of the Maladians wore armor in battle, had astounding agility, and were skilled with blasters, decapitator discs, and vibroblades. The Maladians were so good at fighting that they could wound or even kill Jedi Knights, and when confronted by the powers of the Muun Sith Lord, did not flee but attacked him instead, almost overwhelming the Muun.<ref name="Darth P" />

After the Maladian commander that Pestage dealt with was humiliated by the way the Kim affair was dealt with, the Maladian informed Pestage of a Maladian contract that targeted someone allied with Damask Holdings, who turned out to be Damask himself. The Maladians were also prepared to commit suicide to prevent their information falling into the wrong hands, seen when the female Maladian did so after Ronhar Kim captured her.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
In flashbacks of the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Republic 64|''Republic'' 64]], released in [[2004]], the female of a then yet to be unidentified organization appeared.<ref name="R64">[[Republic 64|''Republic'' 64]]</ref> That organization was first identified as the Maladians in [[2012]]'s novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth P" /> The Maladians appear in ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', also released in 2012.<ref name="Read">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
